This '''garage owner''' lived on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], who acquired the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Barada/Legends|Barada]] from his parents. Barada was sold due to being a disrespectful [[Youngling/Legends|child]] and became the garage owner's indentured servant.

At a later date, the owner was challenged by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. Jabba rigged the game, and the garage owner soon lost both his garage and Barada.
